note: Two encoded-format enums exist. Bitstream tag 84 and codec.encoded_format use the internal ENCODED_FORMAT values. CFHD_PrepareToEncode uses CFHD_EncodedFormat. They are not the same numbers.

values.name: FIELDPLUS
values.note: TRANSFORM_TYPE_LAST. Default fieldplus constants are 6 wavelets, 3 spatial, 17 subbands.

sample_flags.name: SAMPLE_FLAGS_PROGRESSIVE
sample_flags.meaning: First transform is spatial. PutVideoSampleFlags omits the tag entirely when flags are zero, so an interlaced GOP-1 sample has no progressive bit rather than an explicit interlaced tag.

reconstruction.meaning: GOP-1 interlaced forward path. Pairs rows and calls FilterInterlacedRecursiveStrip. Does not change TRANSFORM_TYPE away from SPATIAL when GOP length is 1.
Full-resolution YUYV inverse used when codec->progressive is false. Inverts horizontal bands, then a field/temporal step with field_pitch = 2 * output_pitch.
For precision other than 16: shift by (16-precision), then saturate to 0..65535. Word order is little-endian Y0, V, Y1, U. U is read from planar channel 2 and V from planar channel 1.
Different packing. Saturates in the coded domain before the shift.
Interlaced GOP-1 marks subband 8 with difference coding, codebook 2, and peaks when DIFFERENCE_CODING is enabled. Progressive GOP-1 does not.
GOP-1 spatial divisor is 8 on chroma, which is frame width divisible by 16 and height divisible by 8.

hypercine_gaps: No capability bit distinguishes RGB444 from RGBA4444.
No capability reports the coded-precision set.
Non-strict ParseCineFormSample still requires exactly 30 bands, so it cannot describe RGB, RGBA, Bayer, or 17-subband fieldplus samples.
QueueDecode rejects payloads above 32 MiB with SampleTooLarge. That limit is HyperCine policy, not a CineForm sample limit.
